title.narrative: Non-Food Items Support to the Emergency Response - Floods and Cyclone Idai in Mozambique

description.narrative: This activity Non-Food Items Support to the Emergency Response - Floods and Cyclone Idai in Mozambique is a component of Emergency Response to Cyclones Idai and Kenneth in Mozambique reported by FCDO with a funding type of 104 - Procurement of Services and a budget of £4,134,340. It works in the following sector(s): Material relief assistance and services, Emergency food assistance.
